top_choice_rationale: P001 rewards targeted protein degradation as one coherent achievement: designed bifunctional molecules recruit E3 ligases and destroy chosen proteins catalytically, an event-driven principle reproduced widely. Crews and Deshaies conceived and demonstrated it, and Ciulli's structure-guided VHL ligand and ternary-complex work made it a rational design discipline, which is the most clearly chemical contribution. The citation is scoped to heterobifunctional degraders, so the names match the words. The cost is that Handa and Ito (cereblon) are excluded and no degrader is approved yet. P002 swaps Ciulli for Handa and needs a broader PROTAC-plus-glue citation, so I rank it second. P004 and P003 add a second part that fits less well. Both leave out Ciulli and add a topic that fewer members support. No award ranks last because the central science is mature enough to recognise.
